---------- Hamiltoniano (inicio) ----------\n@dataclass\nclass HamiltonianSpec:\n    n: int\n    h_ideal: float\n    def label(self):\n        return f\"IsingPath(n={self.n})\"\n\nH = HamiltonianSpec(n=8, h_ideal=1.5)\n\n# ---------- QPU ----------\n@dataclass\nclass QPUState:\n    n: int\n    cycle: int\n    t1: Dict[int, float]\n    t2: Dict[int, float]\n    readout: Dict[int, float]\n    detuning: Dict[int, float]\n    gate2q: Dict[int, float]\n    coupling_map: List[Tuple[int, int]]\n    layout: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)\n    dd_on: bool = False\n    dd_seq: str = \"NONE\"\n    phase_vz: float = 0.0\n\ndef evolve_qpu(n, cycle, drift_qubits):\n    t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\n    for q in range(n):\n        t2[q] = max(25.0, 155.0 - 4.5 * cycle) if q in drift_qubits else 150.0 + float(RNG.normal(0, 3))\n        t1[q] = max(30.0, 0.7 * t2[q] + float(RNG.normal(0, 2)))\n        readout[q] = 0.01 + (0.03 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * (cycle / 30.0)\n        detuning[q] = (-27.0 if t2[q] > 100 else -22.0) + float(RNG.normal(0, 0.3))\n        gate2q[q] = 0.006 + (0.01 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * (cycle / 20.0)\n    return QPUState(n, cycle, t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q,\n                    [(i, i+1) for i in range(n-1)], layout=list(range(n)))\n\ndef per_qubit_friction(qpu, q):\n    f = max(0.0, 1.0 - qpu.t2[q]/150.0)*0.35\n    f += max(0.0, 1.0 - qpu.t1[q]/100.0)*0.15\n    f += min(1.0, qpu.readout[q]/0.05)*0.25\n    f += min(1.0, abs(qpu.detuning[q])/30.0)*0.10\n    f += min(1.0, qpu.gate2q[q]/0.02)*0.15\n    return float(np.clip(f, 0, 1))\n\ndef layout_friction(qpu, layout):\n    return float(np.mean([per_qubit_friction(qpu, q) for q in layout]))\n\nprint(\"QPU+H OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.404768Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.405054Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.439900Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.405030Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.439121Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"QPU+H OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":64},{"id":"cac9d9de-3934-4b50-acec-502263314163","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# OJOS — observador no invasivo (continuo) → gobierna MORPH\n# ============================================================\nclass Ojos:\n    \"\"\"Lee solo senales publicas. Interpreta ruido/estado. No escribe en QPU.\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, hist_n=12):\n        self.buf = []\n        self.capacity = hist_n\n        self.regime = Regime.ESTABLE\n\n    def observe(self, qpu: QPUState) -> dict:\n        health = {q: 1.0 - per_qubit_friction(qpu, q) for q in range(qpu.n)}\n        friction = float(np.mean([1.0 - health[q] for q in range(qpu.n)]))\n        self.buf.append(friction)\n        if len(self.buf) > self.capacity:\n            self.buf.pop(0)\n        smoothed = float(np.mean(self.buf))\n        # Schmitt\n        if self.regime == Regime.ESTABLE:\n            if smoothed >= 0.55: self.regime = Regime.INESTABLE\n            if smoothed >= 0.72: self.regime = Regime.CONFLICTO\n        elif self.regime == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            if smoothed >= 0.72: self.regime = Regime.CONFLICTO\n            elif smoothed < 0.35: self.regime = Regime.ESTABLE\n        else:\n            if smoothed < 0.58: self.regime = Regime.INESTABLE\n        candidates = sorted(health, key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        return {\n            \"friction\": friction, \"smoothed\": smoothed, \"regime\": self.regime,\n            \"health\": health, \"candidates\": candidates,\n        }\n\n# ============================================================\n# REFLEJOS / MORPH — siempre activo, gobernado por Ojos\n# ============================================================\nclass Reflejos:\n    def __init__(self, n):\n        self.n = n\n\n    def select(self, qpu: QPUState, eyes: dict) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Ojos administra el ranking; MORPH solo elige independent set.\"\"\"\n        ranked = list(eyes[\"candidates\"])\n        health = eyes[\"health\"]\n        edges = {(min(a,b), max(a,b)) for a,b in qpu.coupling_map}\n        selected, forbidden, avoided = [], set(), 0\n        for q in ranked:\n            if q in forbidden:\n                avoided += 1\n                continue\n            selected.append(q)\n            for a, b in edges:\n                if a == q: forbidden.add(b)\n                elif b == q: forbidden.add(a)\n            if len(selected) >= self.n:\n                break\n        for q in ranked:\n            if len(selected) >= self.n:\n                break\n            if q not in selected:\n                selected.append(q)\n        selected = selected[:self.n]\n        score = float(np.mean([health[q] for q in selected]))\n        qpu.layout = list(selected)  # correccion activa continua\n        return {\"selected\": selected, \"score\": score, \"edges_avoided\": avoided}\n\nprint(\"Ojos→MORPH OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.441242Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.441725Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.468820Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.441698Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.467973Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Ojos→MORPH — recibe Ojos + Observable; dispara DD esporadico\n# ============================================================\nclass Juicio:\n    def __init__(self, thr_morph=0.92, dd_cooldown=5, his_drop=0.05, do_z_min=0.45):\n        self.thr_morph = thr_morph\n        self.dd_cooldown = dd_cooldown   # ciclos minimos entre DD\n        self.his_drop = his_drop\n        self.do_z_min = do_z_min         # umbral alto = esporadico\n        self.prev_his = 1.0\n        self.last_dd_cycle = -999\n\n    def decide(self, H: HamiltonianSpec, cycle: int, eyes: dict, morph: dict,\n               observable: Optional[dict]) -> dict:\n        do_a = max(0.0, self.thr_morph - morph[\"score\"]) * 0.5\n        do_z = eyes[\"friction\"] * 0.8\n        if eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            do_z += 0.20\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            do_z += 0.08\n\n        his_now = self.prev_his\n        his_falling = False\n        if observable is not None:\n            his_now = float(observable.get(\"HIS\", self.prev_his))\n            if his_now < self.prev_his - self.his_drop:\n                his_falling = True\n                do_z += 0.12\n            self.prev_his = his_now\n\n        c, z = abs(do_a) >= 0.20, abs(do_z) >= 0.20\n        if c and z: role = CausalRole.COMBINACION\n        elif c: role = CausalRole.CAUSA_DIRECTA\n        elif z: role = CausalRole.INDICADOR\n        else: role = CausalRole.NULO\n\n        cooled = (cycle - self.last_dd_cycle) >= self.dd_cooldown\n        # DD solo si: causa latente fuerte + (conflicto o HIS cayendo) + cooldown\n        want_dd = (\n            cooled\n            and do_z >= self.do_z_min\n            and (eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.CONFLICTO or his_falling)\n        )\n\n        if want_dd:\n            self.last_dd_cycle = cycle\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, \"causal_dd_sporadic\", float(do_z)\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.ESTABLE and morph[\"score\"] >= self.thr_morph:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.HOLD, \"hold\", 0.0\n        else:\n            # Morph ya corrige en continuo; Juicio no re-dispara layout\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.REMAP_ONLY, \"morph_already_active\", float(do_a)\n\n        return {\n            \"role\": role, \"intervention\": inter, \"targets\": list(morph[\"selected\"]),\n            \"expected_gain\": gain, \"reason\": reason, \"do_a\": do_a, \"do_z\": do_z,\n            \"regime\": eyes[\"regime\"], \"his_falling\": his_falling, \"cooled\": cooled,\n        }\n\n# ============================================================\n# MANOS — solo si Juicio autoriza DD\n# ============================================================\nclass Manos:\n    def act(self, H: HamiltonianSpec, qpu: QPUState, plan: dict) -> dict:\n        dd = plan[\"intervention\"] == Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL\n        seq = \"NONE\"\n        phase = 0.0\n        if dd:\n            seq = \"XY4\" if abs(H.h_ideal) > 2.0 else \"CPMG\"\n            tg = plan[\"targets\"] or list(qpu.layout)\n            phase = float(np.mean([qpu.detuning.get(q, 0.0) for q in tg])) * 1e-3\n        qpu.dd_on = dd\n        qpu.dd_seq = seq\n        qpu.phase_vz = phase\n        return {\"dd_applied\": dd, \"sequence\": seq, \"phase_vz\": phase,\n                \"probe_state\": \"degraded\" if dd else \"stable\", \"layout\": list(qpu.layout)}\n\nprint(\"Juicio→Manos OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.471123Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.471492Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.497256Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.471461Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:46:10.496253Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Juicio→Manos list(qpu.layout) if (actuated and qpu.layout) else list(range(qpu.n))\n    dd = qpu.dd_on if actuated else False\n    phase = abs(qpu.phase_vz) if actuated else 0.0\n    fr = layout_friction(qpu, layout)\n    mit = 1.0\n    if dd:\n        mit *= 0.62\n    if phase > 0:\n        mit *= max(0.85, 1.0 - min(0.1, phase))\n    # beneficio continuo de MORPH: layout saludable reduce friccion ya en h_real, \"HIS\": HIS(H.h_ideal, h_real),\n    }\n\nCONFIG = {\n    \"n_cycles\": 30,\n    \"his_floor\": 0.15,\n    \"drift_qubits\": [1, 3, 5, 6],\n    \"dd_cooldown\": 5,\n    \"do_z_min\": plan[\"intervention\"].value,\n                     \"regime\": plan[\"regime\"].value},\n        \"hands\": hands,\n        \"workload_base\": wl_base,\n        \"workload_eqg\": wl_eqg,\n        \"observable\": obs_fb,\n    })\n    if c % 5 == 0 or c == CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"] - 1 or hands[\"dd_applied\"]:\n        print(\"c=%02d  HIS_b=%.3f HIS_e=%.3f  regime=%s  int=%s  dd=%s  doZ=%.2f\" % (\n            c, wl_base[\"HIS\"], wl_eqg[\"HIS\"], eyes[\"regime\"].value,\n            plan[\"intervention\"].value, hands[\"dd_applied\"], plan[\"do_z\"]))\n\nhis_b = [h[\"workload_base\"][\"HIS\"] for h in hist]\nhis_e = [h[\"workload_eqg\"][\"HIS\"] for h in hist]\ndd_n = sum(1 for h in hist if h[\"hands\"][\"dd_applied\"])\nprint(\"\\nDD cycles: %d/%d (debe ser << 30)\" % (dd_n,
